risks.title: Strong dependence on single tenant (UHS)
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in the risk factors (Item 1A) and concerns 40% of revenues. UHS's inability to renew its leases or exercise its purchase options without substitute arrangements would have a major impact on revenues.

risks.title: Impact of rising interest rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and mentions the impact on interest expenses, access to capital markets, investment capacity, and the value of properties and shares. The intensity of language suggests significant concern.

risks.title: Regulatory changes in the healthcare sector
risks.score_rationale: Multiple sections detail the potential impact of new legislation (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, ACA, IRA) on Medicaid/Medicare funding and tax credits. The language is strong ('material adverse impact').

risks.title: Risks related to inflation and staffing shortages
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with notable intensity, mentioning the impact on tenant results and the ability to pay rents. While recently moderated, the risk of persistence or worsening is highlighted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described with great precision and detail, emphasizing potential costs, data loss, fines, reputation damage, and potentially insufficient insurance coverage. The language is strong ('material adverse effect').

risks.title: Competition in the real estate market
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of general and specific real estate markets (office space, medical centers). The impact on results and property value is emphasized.

risks.title: Risks related to general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is linked to economic and market conditions, affecting the ability to obtain capital and refinance debt. It is also linked to increased unemployment and the number of uninsured individuals.

ai_positioning.summary: UHT does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial operations, investments, and properties, without any reference to AI or related technology.
